app.name: Wii Ran AI
app.short_description: Local stories and chat on your Wii
app.long_description: Stories, Nano Chat, or larger Medium Chat. Chat is experimental; replies may be wrong. Medium model files are on SD. D-pad selects, A types, B deletes, Minus spaces, Plus generates, Home quits. Context: 2,048 Nano / 512 Medium.
